icon.label: Icon
icon.description: Glyph shown in the bar. Colour still follows severity regardless of which icon is picked.

poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to re-read system health. Each poll runs stoa-vitals-status (doctor log, sensors, disk, pending updates).

show_badge.label: Show issue count
show_badge.description: Display the number of open issues next to the icon while any are outstanding.
